name: GitHub

notes.text: Composio's shared GitHub app lets you start today, but a paid Marketplace listing must be your own app.
Composio's shared GitHub app lets you start today; use your own GitHub App for your name on the install screen.

summary: No review is needed to build and use a GitHub App; org owners may need to approve installs. Only a paid Marketplace listing has requirements.

gates.title: Create a GitHub App

blockers.symptom: Install in an organisation is pending
blockers.fix: Ask an org owner to approve it.

gates.nextStep: In GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → New GitHub App, set the callback URL to the redirect URI https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback and choose only the permissions you need.

gates.title: Paid Marketplace listing
gates.nextStep: When you have a verified publisher and enough installs, submit the paid listing from your app's Marketplace settings.
gates.whatToAsk: Ask GitHub Marketplace support: "What is the current review time for a paid listing?"

requirements.label: Verified publisher
howToGet: Apply for publisher verification from your organization's Marketplace settings on GitHub.
requirements.whatToAsk: Ask GitHub Marketplace support how long publisher verification takes for your organization.

requirements.label: 100 installs (GitHub App) or 200 users (OAuth App)
howToGet: Grow installs outside the Marketplace first
requirements.whatToAsk: Ask yourself: how many installs do you have today, and how many weeks until 100?

claims.text: GitHub Apps are recommended over OAuth Apps; no review is needed to create or use one outside the Marketplace, though org owners may need to approve.

sources.quote: No review to create/use outside Marketplace; org owners may need to approve.

claims.text: A paid Marketplace listing needs a verified publisher and 100 installs (GitHub App) or 200 users (OAuth App). Review duration not found.

sources.quote: Paid Marketplace listing: verified publisher + 100 installs (GitHub App) / 200 users (OAuth App).
